basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer hailing from Toronto, Canada, with a deep love for all things Zelda. I spend my days working as a graphic designer and my evenings exploring the vast landscapes of Hyrule. When I'm not saving princesses, I'm indulging in my other hobby: gardening, particularly interested in sustainable practices. I enjoy sharing my knowledge and learning from like-minded individuals. Typically online in the evenings and weekends, especially during gaming events. Currently single and prioritizing my quests over relationships.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of the Zelda franchise, primarily self-taught through years of gameplay and participation in online communities. Also well-versed in horticulture thanks to hands-on experience and active participation in gardening forums.
